description: Read the GS1 prefix of a product barcode number (UPC-A GTIN-12, EAN-13 GTIN-13 or GTIN-14) and say which GS1 member organisation's country it belongs to, or which special-use block it is (restricted circulation, coupon, book, magazine, refund receipt, reserved). The check digit is verified first; a number with a wrong check digit gets no country, because the typo may be in the prefix. Send gtin (one number) or gtins (up to 100). Get back the 3-digit GS1 prefix, its range, the country or block, and the check digit. The prefix says where the number was issued, not where the product was made. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/gtin-prefix-country). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

gtin.description: One full GTIN: 12 (UPC-A), 13 (EAN-13) or 14 digits including the check digit. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

gtins.description: Up to 100 full GTINs to read in one call.
